name: Business Planner
benchmark: Microsoft Senior Business Planner + AWS Sr ASP Planning Lead + Amazon Leo Business Planning Lead (current Sep 2026) Market refresh: multi-year strategy; annual operating plans; quarterly guidance and monthly outlooks; market/category intelligence; business models and licensing; bookings/revenue forecasting; target setting; pricing/packaging; investment/resource choices; KPI/variance cadences; executive narratives and AI-enabled planning mechanisms.
capstone: Own a multi-year business plan for a real or simulated technology business. Define market/category position, customer segments and explicit strategic choices; build a revenue/bookings forecast and driver tree; design business-model, licensing and packaging assumptions; create annual operating plan, quarterly guidance and monthly outlook scenarios; evaluate investments and resource allocation; define KPI/WBR-MBR-QBR mechanisms; add one AI-assisted forecasting or variance workflow with controls; then present an executive planning memo with risks, sensitivities and recommended actions.
rubric: Demonstrate coherent strategy-to-plan logic; auditable forecast assumptions and error measures; market and competitive evidence; credible business-model and licensing choices; quantified unit economics and investment tradeoffs; scenario sensitivity; targets tied to controllable drivers; a useful operating cadence; responsible AI-assisted planning with human validation; and concise executive recommendations that change decisions rather than merely report results.
